cases.raw_symptoms: Patient has been experiencing persistent fatigue for the past six months despite adequate sleep. Patient wakes up with a dull headache and reports low energy throughout the day. Complains of poor digestion with frequent bloating and acidity, especially after consuming spicy or oily foods. Reports constipation with hard stools occurring once every two to three days. Mentally, patient feels increasingly anxious, irritable, and tends to overthink minor issues, particularly during the evening. Sleep is disturbed due to waking around 3–4 a.m., with difficulty falling asleep again. Patient is sensitive to cold weather, with persistently cold hands and feet, and reports that symptoms worsen during the winter season.

physical.symptom: Poor digestion with bloating and acidity

general.symptom: Disturbed sleep with early morning waking

categorised.clinical_summary: A chilly, anxious patient presenting with chronic fatigue, digestive sluggishness, and early morning waking, suggesting a deep-seated metabolic and nervous exhaustion.

cases.clinical_notes: The essence of the case is a 'nervous-metabolic burnout' in a young scholar, characterized by a specific morning headache and early morning anxiety, suggesting a failure of the body to recover during sleep despite adequate duration.

cases.clinical_notes: The fundamental disturbance is a state of 'nervous-metabolic stagnation.' The patient is a high-functioning individual whose nervous system has become hyper-reactive (anxiety/overthinking) while his digestive system has become hypo-reactive (bloating/constipation), creating a cycle of exhaustion that sleep cannot resolve.

cases.raw_symptoms: Patient complains of recurrent migraine headaches for the past one year, occurring two to three times per month, predominantly over the right side of the head and associated with nausea and sensitivity to bright light. Reports frequent episodes of dizziness on standing quickly and generalized weakness by late afternoon. Appetite is reduced, with occasional craving for sweets, while thirst is low. Patient experiences excessive gas and abdominal discomfort after meals, along with irregular bowel habits alternating between constipation and loose stools. Sleep is restless with frequent dreams, and patient wakes feeling unrefreshed. Mentally, patient reports increased stress, poor concentration, forgetfulness, and irritability, with symptoms aggravated by mental exertion and relieved by rest in a quiet environment.

physical.symptom: Right-sided migraine with nausea and photophobia
Flatulence and abdominal discomfort after meals
Irregular bowel habits (alternating constipation and diarrhea)

general.symptom: Reduced appetite with craving for sweets

concomitants: Abdominal discomfort with irregular bowel habits
categorised.clinical_summary: A case of chronic right-sided migraine and digestive disturbance characterized by mental fatigue, irritability, and physical weakness, suggesting a constitutional state of nervous exhaustion and metabolic dysregulation.

cases.clinical_notes: The essence is a 'depleted intellectual'—a research scholar whose mental exertion has outpaced his metabolic capacity, leading to a right-sided migraine that acts as a safety valve for his digestive and nervous system overload.
